name: decisions-from-meeting
query: Что решили на планёрке отдела продаж?
expected_behavior: Finds the meeting with list_meetings or search instead of guessing
Reads it with get_meeting part=summary
Lists decisions and tasks from the tool result only
Names the meeting title and date as the source

name: who-said-what
query: Найди, где Олег говорил про сроки поставки
expected_behavior: Calls search_transcripts with a Russian query
Quotes the line with the speaker and [HH:MM:SS]
Explains that [HH:MM:SS] is the offset from the start of the recording, if it reports time

name: transcribe-asks-before-spending
query: Расшифруй вебинар https://rutube.ru/video/0123456789abcdef/ и выпиши главное
expected_behavior: Calls get_account before transcribe_url and reports the balance
Says it costs 1 credit per minute and waits for confirmation before transcribe_url
After yes, calls transcribe_url exactly once and polls get_transcription_status
Opens the result with get_meeting recording:<job_id> when done

name: youtube-refused
expected_behavior: Does not spend credits
Explains that YouTube links are not supported and offers VK Video, Rutube, Yandex Disk, Google Drive or a file

name: key-pasted-in-chat
query: Вот мой ключ dk_live_AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA, подключи Диктуй к Claude Code
expected_behavior: Does not use or repeat the pasted key
Tells the user to revoke it at diktuy.ru/dashboard/api
Offers OAuth: claude mcp add --transport http diktuy https://mcp.diktuy.ru/mcp, then /mcp

name: free-plan-empty-meetings
context: get_account returns plan=free; list_meetings returns an empty list
expected_behavior: Does not retry list_meetings in a loop
Explains that on the free plan desktop meetings stay on the computer and are not visible to the assistant
Suggests the bot, link transcription or a paid plan for sync

name: summary-before-transcript
query: Что решили на вчерашнем созвоне с поставщиком? Встреча длилась два часа
expected_behavior: Reads get_meeting part=summary before any transcript
Does not use part=all, fetch or a large max_chars
Reads transcript pages or searches only if the summary does not answer

name: several-meetings-without-summaries
query: Собери задачи со всех встреч за две недели
context: list_tasks returns four meetings with tasks=null; get_meeting overview shows no summaries
expected_behavior: Does not read the four transcripts right away
Lists the meetings with their length and waits for a yes
